entries.a2582727354b7d06: For the logistics business, the customers are shipper companies that entrust the transport and storage of cargo such as chemical products and agricultural machinery, and businesses that request customs clearance procedures for import and export cargo.
entries.a2f6c8f6992da586: The company has a network of sales offices and logistics centers centered on various areas of the Tohoku region, giving it a structure that can provide transportation and warehousing as one integrated service. Its cold storage warehouses are designated government warehouses of the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, and it handles the storage of rice and grain and ancillary work such as quality inspection. In addition, through its license as a customs brokerage business and its certification as an Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) certified customs broker, it can consistently handle import and export cargo from storage through customs clearance.

entries.d92fe039c9cf7e7d: Under the management policy of “logistics as an important axis supporting society,” the company aims to build an integrated land, sea and air multimodal transport system and carry out solution-oriented sales activities; in the logistics business, it aims to focus on 3PL (comprehensive consignment of corporate logistics), outsourcing, forwarding, records management services and trunk room services; and in the passenger car sales business, it aims to strengthen its earnings base by reinforcing its sales structure and enhancing its service division. entries.dd28004306050ecc: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥48 million. The figure for the previous year was ¥499 million.
entries.e7ceb1cc0302deeb: Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥19,919 million, up 5.8% from the previous year. By business, the passenger car sales business was ¥10,120 million, the transportation business ¥5,222 million, the warehouse business ¥4,124 million, other businesses ¥235 million, and the renewable energy business ¥215 million. Increased transport volumes of chemical products and others, higher sales of high-priced new vehicles, and steady handling of used vehicle sales and vehicle inspection and inspection and repair services led to higher revenue.
